layout.spacing_scale: dense (p-2, p-4, p-6) to maximize data visibility on mobile.
layout.grid: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3) with tight gaps (gap-2 to gap-4).
layout.borders: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08) on all cards, zero border-radius or max rounded-md (6px).

components.buttons: Square or slight rounded corners. Primary actions in #319842 with high-contrast black text.
components.cards: Flat solid #141414 backgrounds. No drop shadows. Use 1px inner border. For Platinum Wall, apply subtle top-border highlight.
components.inputs: Shadcn UI customized. Deep dark backgrounds (#000000) with #319842 focus rings.
components.ticker: react-fast-marquee at the bottom. Font: monospace, Color: #319842 on #0D0D0D background.
components.tabs: Full-width flex containers. Active tab gets a 2px bottom border of #319842 or #00558C.
components.badges: SVG icons (Lucide Crown/Flame) with text-shadow glow, rendered in #FFD700 or #FF8C00.
components.deltas: Use lucide-react ArrowUpRight (green #319842) and ArrowDownRight (red #FF3B30) for positive/negative changes.

animations.marquee: Continuous smooth scroll for the ticker.
animations.transitions: Fast, crisp (0.15s ease-out) to feel like a responsive trading terminal.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark metallic curves with textured surfaces
image_urls.instructions: Use with low opacity (10-15%) overlay in the Hero or Dashboard header to break up the flat black without reducing data clarity.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a mobile-first 'Sports scoreboard meets trading floor' UI. Apply Archetype 2 (Performance Pro) with a dark theme (#0D0D0D background).

Use 'Barlow Condensed', 'Chivo', or a similar condensed heavy sans for all headings to establish the scoreboard feel. Use Inter for body text as requested, but keep headings distinct to adhere to anti-default typography rules.
Install and use 'react-fast-marquee' for the real-time agent sales ticker pinned to the bottom of the screen. Display format: '[Agent Name] - $[ALP] - [Market] - [Reps Collected]'.
For the Nightly Pulse Entry, build a dense mobile-first stepper form using Shadcn UI Form, Input, and Button components.
The Platinum Wall (Vets vs Rookies) should use a side-by-side split layout displaying Top 3 in each category.
Use Lucide icons (Crown, Flame) in gold and orange for badges instead of image files, scaling them with Framer Motion for celebratory effects.
Build the UI with Tailwind CSS utilizing 'tabular-nums' for all metrics/numbers to prevent layout shifting during real-time updates.
Add 'data-testid' attributes to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, alerts).
Create strict red (#FF3B30) and yellow (#EAB308) top banner alert states for the 6:01 AM 'Missed' and 9:01 PM 'Warning' rules.
